# Dmultichoice Tutoring - AI Agent Context

## About
Dmultichoice Tutoring is Nigeria's most trusted online tutoring platform, empowering students for academic excellence since 2020. We specialize in live online lessons, assignment solving, homework help, task assistance, and exam preparation for JAMB, WAEC, NECO, IELTS, SAT.

## Core Services

### Online Lessons
- Live interactive video lessons with expert Nigerian tutors
- Interactive digital whiteboards for visual learning
- All subjects: Mathematics, English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Government, Economics, Literature, CRS, Accounting, Commerce, Further Maths, Coding for Kids
- Flexible scheduling: Weekdays and weekends
- Recorded lessons available for revision

### Assignment Solving
- Complex assignment help with step-by-step solutions
- All academic levels: Secondary school, university, professional courses
- Subjects covered: All science, arts, and commercial subjects
- Turnaround time: 2-6 hours for urgent tasks
- Detailed explanations so you understand the solution

### Homework Help
- Same-day homework assistance
- WhatsApp support for quick questions
- Photo upload of homework for instant help
- Guided solutions (we help you solve, not just give answers)

### Task Assistance
- Academic projects and coursework help
- Research assistance and data analysis
- Presentation preparation
- Report writing and essay assistance

## Exam Preparation
- JAMB UTME (all subjects) - CBT simulator included
- WAEC SSCE (all subjects)
- NECO SSCE (all subjects)
- IELTS (Academic & General Training)
- SAT (Math & Evidence-Based Reading/Writing)

## Pricing
- **Assignment Help** - From ₦5,000 per task (depends on complexity)
- **Online Lessons** - ₦50,000/month: 2 group sessions/week, recorded lessons, study materials
- **JAMB Intensive** - ₦75,000/month: 5 sessions/week, CBT simulator, 10,000+ questions [MOST POPULAR]
- **Private 1-on-1** - ₦120,000/month: 3 private sessions/week, dedicated tutor, flexible scheduling

## How to Get Help
1. Visit dmultichoicetutoring.com
2. Select a service at #pricing
3. Click "Enroll Now" or "Get Help"
4. Complete payment via Flutterwave (secure)
5. Receive tutor assignment or solved assignment
